dashboardScreens.attentionTruncated: Only loaded attention items are shown. Kind counts are lower bounds; more items may be unavailable.
dashboardScreens.definition.inProgress: Tasks with In Progress status in the selected project and discipline scope
dashboardScreens.definition.review: Tasks Ready for Review or In Review in the selected project and discipline scope
dashboardScreens.definition.overdue: Tasks counted as overdue by this scope's task list
dashboardScreens.definition.upcoming: Open deliverables due from today through 14 days ahead in this scope
dashboardScreens.definition.decpending: Pending, Under Review or Deferred decisions across the whole project
dashboardScreens.definition.issuesOpen: Issues counted as open by the project's issue register, across the whole project
dashboardScreens.staffingUnavailable: Staffing hours cannot be assessed without a current forward target window
dashboardScreens.noTarget: No dated open submission package or milestone
dashboardScreens.overdueTarget: This target is overdue. There is no forward window to assess; hours are unavailable.
dashboardScreens.staffingDefinition: Remaining estimates for open tasks due in this window, confirmed reservations and open-role demand are separate figures. On Hold tasks are open; Complete and Cancelled are excluded. Open roles never enter confirmed hours, a person's load or the comparison.
dashboardScreens.visibleAllocations: Confirmed figures cover only allocations you may view; full discipline totals and comparisons are unavailable.
dashboardScreens.unattributedReservation: Known unattributed confirmed reservations: {hours}. Other reservations may be unavailable; exact discipline comparisons are not asserted.
dashboardScreens.noDisciplines: No discipline staffing facts in this scope
